visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and pink highlights, wearing a grey ribbed long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans, sits in front of a silver laptop. She looks directly at the camera with an expressive face, holding a black iPhone in her left hand and a white coiled USB-C cable in her right. The setting is a living room with a beige fabric sofa in the background and warm, bright indoor lighting. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of an iPhone screen held by hands with white and blue patterned nail art. The screen displays the iOS home screen with various app icons. A finger taps on the 'Settings' icon, then navigates to 'Personal Hotspot' and toggles the switch for 'Allow Others to Join' to the 'on' (green) position. (3) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman. She physically plugs the white USB cable into the bottom port of the iPhone and then connects the other end into the left side of the silver laptop. (4) The laptop screen is shown in a close-up, displaying the YouTube home page for '電獺少女-女孩的科技日常'. The woman's hands are visible on the keyboard and trackpad. (5) The woman leans her chin on the back of the laptop lid, looking up at the camera with a playful and curious expression. The lighting remains soft and natural. (6) A technical shot shows the rear I/O panel of a desktop PC tower with various ports (DVI, HDMI, USB, Audio). A large red 'X' graphic is overlaid on the screen. (7) Final shot of the woman sitting behind the laptop, holding the white cable coiled between her hands. She smiles and gestures with a confident posture as yellow variety-show style text appears near her face.
